Privacy policy

Updated November 9, 2026

La Paix du Cœur complies with Québec’s Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as amended by Law 25.

Person in charge of personal information

Name: [to confirm]
Email: lapaixducoeur.ca@gmail.com

You can write to them to access, correct or delete your information, or to withdraw your consent.

What we collect

  • Forms (contact, volunteering, prayer, newsletter): only what you write to us — name, email and message. This is used only to reply to you and is never sold or traded.
  • Gifts: payments are processed by Zeffy, under its own privacy policy. We never see your card details.
  • Letter of Hope: your email, with your express consent, in line with Canada’s Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL). Every issue includes an unsubscribe link.

Cookieless analytics

We use Cloudflare Web Analytics, a cookieless tool that does not follow you across sites or build a profile. That is why this site shows no consent banner.

Videos

YouTube videos load only after you click, from the youtube-nocookie.com domain. Before that click, no data is sent to YouTube.

Photos and consent

No photo of a person we serve is published without their informed consent — or that of their parent or guardian for a minor. We use first names only and never publish an exact location. To have a photo removed, write to our privacy officer and it will be taken down promptly.

Retention and hosting

Messages are kept as long as needed to reply, then deleted after one year [to confirm]. Some providers (Cloudflare, Zeffy, Google) may process data outside Québec; we have assessed these transfers as Law 25 requires.

Confidentiality incidents

If an incident creates a risk of serious harm, we will notify the people concerned and the Commission d’accès à l’information.
